_note: Trang Du an /projects (gop /robotics 2026-11-14). Chi ghi phan nguoi quyet: nhom, trang thai, buoc tiep, mo ta ngan, chay-duoc (works = da thu that tren mach), huong dan (guide = GUIDE.md, wiring = file yaml so do dau day). Anh, so ban in, PDF, ngay cap nhat: Toolhub tu doc tu thu muc du an. Du an khong co o day: maker/ -> nhom 'khac', ngoai maker/ -> 'tools'. Doi trang thai -> sua file nay trong cung commit.
